annotations.title: Nearest transport and schools to a site

description:
The nearest bus stops, rail stations, metro or tram stops, ferry
    terminals and open schools to a site, straight-line in metres, with names
    and NaPTAN or school references. A school catchment is not a distance,
    and the school's phase is not held. England (stops GB where published).
    Free.
